column1: # svm-finish lane, NVIDIA H200 (RunPod pod 4oih8bhjepzlmm, driver 570.211.01).
# The driver is below Mojo's CUDA floor (needs >= 580 / CUDA 13), so every run here sets
# MODULAR_NVPTX_COMPILER_PATH to the pod's ptxas 12.9.86 (nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12 12.9.86),
# which is Modular's documented older-driver path. The four fit hashes below equal the
# H100 rows of bench/results/svm_speed_2026-09-11/, so the assembler change moves no bits.
# Commit 7a9b6f55 (lane/svm-finish: origin/main 4dc4346a merged with lane/svm-speed 48f92b19)
# plus the kernel-matrix row fix that makes -D MOJOLEARN_SVM_SCHED_RARY_TREE reach the
# schedule at all (48f92b19 added the constant and the arity row but no branch in
# svm_block_solve_schedule_for, so its R-ary kernel had never been selected by anything).
# Timing: svm_probe.py time, 1 warm fit then 5 fits, no stage clock, IDENTICAL,
# taxi block 10,000 x 11 standardized fit rows, RBF, C 1, gamma 1/d, tol 1e-3.
# Evidence: ~/mojolearn-evidence/svm-finish-2026-09-11/.
arm
FUSED_TREE 2628
TREE (2623 default on NVIDIA above 512)
RARY_TREE arity 16
RARY_TREE arity 32, no trailing or second update barrier
RARY_TREE arity 32
# Every arm above also gave the synthetic fits n=400/600/2000 = 457e29b82bca9df9,
# 733a383c5699f427, 2b66bc991a9c9ed0 (equal to DEVIATIONS 2623, 2627 and 2628's H100 rows),
# from five binaries with five different sha256, so each schedule was really reached.
# READ: the R-ary tree loses badly on this GPU. It trades barriers for work per thread: at
# arity 32 one thread in 32 folds 31 threadgroup slots in a runtime loop while the other 31
# idle, so two levels cost more than the binary tree's twelve cheap ones. Arity 16 (three
# levels, 15 slots per leader) is the least bad of the three and still 1.53x of FUSED_TREE.
# Dropping the trailing and second update barriers is worth about 0.4 percent of the R-ary
# arm, which is another way of saying barriers are not what this kernel is spending on.
# The Istella-S cells of the R-ary arms were not measured: taxi rules the shape out, and the
# flip candidate (FUSED_TREE) is carried to both datasets by the race instead.
